capture_boundary.meaning: Transport seam; MessageController intercepts every outbound message before the wrapped transport's Send would run

pending_store.meaning: in-memory pending map keyed by MessageID, guarded by the controller mutex

entrypoint.meaning: test-mode Transport.Send: captures a stable snapshot into the pending store and suppresses the original send

message_capture.copy_strategy: Message.Clone() deep snapshot taken at capture time; ListPending returns copies so callers cannot mutate the store
message_capture.production_mode: v0.1 has no production mode; the controller always captures and suppresses, and the wrapped Transport is retained but never invoked
message_capture.test_mode: NewMessageController(Transport) creates an active test-mode controller; Send captures and suppresses from construction; no enable/disable toggle in v0.1
notes: Capture happens before the original send and that send is suppressed: MessageController.Send returns nil without invoking the wrapped transport, so a captured message never continues automatically along the original send path.
No scheduling policy is implemented; the pending store is a simple map with monotonic CaptureSequence ordering.
Outbound capture (Send) may run concurrently with controller operations; a single mutex guards the store.
No IN_FLIGHT state: controller operations (Inject, ClearPending) are serialized via the controller mutex.

capture_boundary.meaning: normal protocol input boundary used for injection delivery

pending_store.meaning: shared pending store; the selected message is removed only after delivery succeeds

entrypoint.meaning: selects a pending message by MessageID and delivers it through the recorded target's normal protocol input

message_injection.copy_strategy: delivers a fresh Message.Clone() of the pending snapshot; content and destination are never mutated
message_injection.production_mode: injection is a test-only controller operation with no production counterpart
message_injection.test_mode: Inject(messageID) looks up the pending message by ID, calls the recorded target node's Step with a clone, and consumes the message only on success
notes: If the underlying delivery returns an error (e.g., ErrPaused), the message is preserved in PENDING state and the error is returned.
Injection selects by MessageID and uses the recorded target (the message To field); the target node must be registered via Register.
Controller operations Inject and ClearPending are serialized; outbound capture may proceed concurrently.
Delivery enters through the normal protocol boundary (Node.Step), which validates message.To, clones on entry, and processes under the node mutex.
